simple.meaning: a plan , usually evil ( machination ), sometimes good ( sagacity )
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מְזִמָּה (H4209) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 19 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מְזִמָּה (mᵉzimmâh) means a plan , usually evil ( machination ), sometimes good ( sagacity ) First listed occurrence: Jer 11 15.

definitions.short: a plan , usually evil ( machination ), sometimes good ( sagacity )
definitions.usage: (wicked) device, discretion, intent, witty invention, lewdness, mischievous (device), thought, wickedly.
definitions.full: H4209. mezimmah מְזִמָּה noun feminine purpose, discretion, device (Jeremiah and Wisdom Literature), מְזִמָּה Job 42:2 5 t.; הַמְּזִמָּ֫תָה Jer 11:15 **altogether תָעָתֵךְ מֵעָלַיִח יִעֲבִרוּ קֹדֶשׁ וּבְשַׂר ַהנְדָרִים מְזִמֹּת עָֽשְׂתָה (but read for ׳המ רַבִּים with ַהנְדָרִים הַמְּזִמֹּת ᵐ5 ); מְזִמָּתוֺ 51:11 ; plural absolute מְזִמּוֺת Psa 37:7 7 t.; construct id. Jer 23:20 ; 30:24 ; suffix מְזִמּוֺתָיו Psa 10:4 ; — 1 of ׳י 's purposes Job 42:2 ; chiefly in punishment (compare זִמָּה זָמַם, ) Jer 23:20 ; 30:24 ; 51:11 (|| זמם 51:12 ). 2 power of devising, discretion Prov 1:4 (|| דַּעַת ), 2:11 (|| תְּבוּנָה ), 3:21 (|| תֻּשִׁיָּה ), 5:2 (|| דַּעַת ); מְזִמּוֺת דַּעַת 8:12 . 3. a. evil thoughts of men Psa 10:4 , evil devices of men Job 21:27 (|| מחשׁבות ), Psa 10:2 ; 21:12 (both with חָשַׁב ). b. wickedness in act Jer 11:15 ; Psa 37:7 (both with עָשָׂה ), 139:20 לִמְזִמָּה = wickedly ; — note phrases: אישׁ מְזִמּוֺת a man of (evil) devices (or practices ) Prov 12:2 (opposed to טוֺכ ) 14:17 ; בַּעַלמְֿזִמּוֺת 24:8 (|| לְהָרֵעַ מְחַשֵּׁב ; see בַּעַל ).
